scope: Bounded public-source discovery for camera 222 physical references; no external contact or paid source.

sources.service_description: 2013 Aerial Imagery from LARIAC4 - acquired from Eagle Aerial
sources.assessment: Georeferenced public aerial source exists, but this is 2013 imagery. No current-view point correspondence table, local ground-distance conversion, positional accuracy evidence or unchanged-landmark check was established. Tile resolution is not survey accuracy; Web Mercator coordinate units are not silently ground-distance truth.
Official GIS page exposes maps/open-data routes, but the bounded check did not retrieve a survey/as-built scaled control table for this camera. No request to the city was sent.

required_next_evidence: Dated survey/as-built or suitably accurate georeferenced imagery with documented scale/datum/positional uncertainty for this intersection.
At least four non-collinear identifiable road-plane image/world correspondences over the selected segment; extra independent validation landmarks/distances not used to fit.
Verified current-view landmark match, local ground-metre coordinates or justified geodesic distances, measurement uncertainty and agreed acceptance tolerances.
not_used_as_measurements: Aerial tile resolution interpreted as ground accuracy
